result.stdout:
signweave — generate typed clients for ASP.NET REST + SignalR APIs.

Usage:
    signweave generate --project <csproj> [--target <name>] [--out <dir>]

Commands:
    generate      Extract IR from an ASP.NET project and emit clients.

Options:
    --project <csproj>    Path to the backend csproj (required).
    --target <name>       Output adapter (typescript|dotnet|vue|react; default: typescript).
    --out <dir>           Output directory (default: ./generated).
    --config <path>       Optional signweave.yaml config for filter/rename rules.
    -h, --help            Show this help and exit.
